name: chemistry-mcp
description: Chemistry MCP: working chemistry rather than chemistry appreciation. The full 118-element periodic table as data (IUPAC masses, Pauling electronegativity, oxidation states, electron configurations), a strict formula parser with molar mass and percent composition, an exact-rational equation balancer with an atom-by-atom proof, stoichiometry with limiting reagent and percent yield, bond-type and VSEPR prediction, acid/base pH including the exact weak-acid solution, and reference tables for polyatomic ions and organic functional groups. Runs as an asset under orchestrator-mcp.
